MicrosoftTeamsOAuthCredential.description:
Microsoft OAuth credential for Teams (via Microsoft Graph).

Uses the centralized Microsoft OAuth flow — credentials are created
automatically when the user connects their Microsoft (work/school) account.
Personal Microsoft accounts are not supported for Teams messaging.

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token for token renewal
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

MicrosoftTeamsOAuthCredential.title: MicrosoftTeamsOAuthCredential
MicrosoftTeamsOAuthCredential.x-credential-instructions: Connect your Microsoft work/school account to access Teams via Microsoft Graph. Personal Microsoft accounts are not supported for Teams messaging.
